about_the_game:
Step into the "Nine Realms": An Adventure in a Fusion of Traditional Xianxia and Trendy Fantasy!

This is a Chinese Xianxia JRPG, you are a swordsman who fights with a mythical Sword. You will adventure In Swirl-Wind City，a metropolis in a fantasy continent name ‘Nine Realms’, where humans and Yaos coexist post a celestial triumph over demons. Your quest: locate the Five Elements Soul Stones to vanquish demons and defend the city.

Immersive Role-Playing Narrative:

  • Explore the fantasy "Nine Realms" world, experiencing an original story that combines the Five Elements, mythical beasts from the "Shan Hai Jing" and traditional Chinese myths.

  • Meet dozens of unique and diverse companions, delve into their individual backstories and bonds, and recruit them through the main storyline and a wealth of personal side quests to fight alongside you.

  • Set against a fictional Xianxia backdrop, this game incorporates unique settings and trendy fantasy urban aesthetics, creating a refreshing visual and narrative experience.

Strategy and Exploration In A Multi-Dungeon World:

  • Freely explore a meticulously designed 2D cartoon side-scrolling multi-dungeon world, with five distinct cultural and visually appealing areas of Swirl-Wind City waiting for you to explore!

  • The unique transformation gameplay allows both the protagonist and companions to transform into a variety of fantasy creatures call ‘Arcanie’ during exploration—use the Arcanie form skills to solve puzzles in the scene, unlock hidden areas and treasures, and make exploration full of fun and a sense of discovery!

  • Map design focuses on player experience: clear goals, convenient teleportation, and rich Easter eggs, reducing unnecessary running around and tedious collection.

Strategically Deep 2v2 Turn-Based Combat:

  • Turn-based combat based on the core mechanism of the Five Elements (Metal, Wood, Water, Fire, Earth) attributes, carefully match your team members and skill combinations to devise strategies to defeat your enemies.

  • Each character has a rich skill pool, combined with a variety of collectible and additional learnable martial arts manuals, to build your own unique and diverse combat strategies!

  • Obtain resources to strengthen your companions and team, experience thrilling boss battles, challenge a variety of martial arts schools, and break through the martial arts realm!

Visually Explosive Feast:

  • Feel the unique artistic style of "acidic trend colors" colliding with "new national style"! Using high saturation, high contrast, bright colors combined with pop comics and graffiti art in a cute and chibi style, it brings a strong visual impact.

Embark on the Journey, at the intersection of tradition and trend, write a new chapter of Xianxia in the Nine Realms!
